name: thirteen
description: A web-based implementation of the card game Thirteen (Tiến Lên), built with vanilla TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

scripts.build: rm -f dist/style_*.css; node bin/generate-version.js && tsc && cp src/*.html src/*.css src/logo.png favicon.ico dist/ && node bin/hash-css.js && node bin/cache-bust.js
scripts.test:coverage: NODE_OPTIONS='--loader tsm' c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html --report-dir=coverage --include='src/**/*.ts' --include='src/**/*.js' node ./node_modules/mocha/bin/mocha.js --require ./tests/setup.ts tests/test_*.ts tests/**/*.ts

author: thekaveman
